title: Tapu's School Complaints & Gokuldham Mischief
tagline: The Beginning of Tapu Sena's Chaos
description: Gokuldham residents and Iyer-Babita complain about Tapu's endless pranks, prompting Jethalal to take Tapu to Gada Electronics.

title: Champaklal's Arrival in Mumbai
tagline: Bapuji Arrives from Village to Gokuldham
description: Champaklal Gada arrives in Mumbai for the first time, causing instant funny clashes with Bhide, Jethalal, and society members.

title: Gokuldham Navratri Disco Dandiya Special
description: Jethalal and Daya get Gokuldham Society hyped for a high-energy Navratri Disco Dandiya competition.

title: Tapu Ki Shaadi (Child Marriage Dream)
tagline: Bapuji's Shocking Marriage Proposal for Tapu
description: Bapuji insists on getting young Tapu married, bringing Jethalal's brother-in-law Sundar from Ahmedabad to handle wedding preparations.

title: Gokuldham Premier League (GPL Season 1)
tagline: Jetha Ke Janbaaz vs Daya Ke Daredevils
description: The inaugural cricket tournament in Gokuldham Society pitting Jethalal's team against Daya's team for ultimate bragging rights.

title: The Famous Bhootni Arc in Gokuldham
tagline: Ghost in White Saree Haunts Society
description: A mysterious ghost in a white saree haunts Gokuldham Society and nearby renovation grounds, terrifying Mohanlal, Bhide, and Jethalal.

title: Champaklal's Unstoppable Hiccups
description: Bapuji suffers from non-stop hiccups that won't go away, prompting the entire Gokuldham society to try hilarious remedies.

title: Gokuldham Premier League (GPL Season 2)
tagline: Jabardast Jetha vs Daya Ke Daredevils
description: The grand second season of GPL with celebrity guests, team auctions, and intense cricket matches.

title: Gokuldham Society Garba Night Special
description: The Mahila Mandal gets Gokuldham Society ready for a grand Garba Night celebration with traditional costumes and dancing.

title: Gulabo Marriage Lawsuit in Kutch
description: A woman named Gulabo arrives in Gokuldham claiming she is Jethalal's lawfully wedded wife from a film shooting in Kutch.
